description: This file defines the class 'RouteCollectorProxy' which is part of the Slim Framework's routing system. It acts as a proxy for route collection, providing methods to define routes (get, post, put, etc.), manage base paths, and handle route groups. It interacts with various interfaces related to HTTP messaging, dependency injection containers, and route collection management.

classes.name: Slim\Routing\RouteCollectorProxy
classes.description: A proxy class that simplifies route collection and grouping within the Slim Framework routing system, delegating route registration to an underlying route collector and managing route groups with a common prefix.

methods.name: getResponseFactory
methods.description: Returns the ResponseFactoryInterface instance used to generate response objects.

methods.name: getCallableResolver
methods.description: Returns the CallableResolverInterface instance responsible for resolving callables for routes.

methods.name: getContainer
methods.description: Returns the optional dependency injection container associated with the proxy, if any.

methods.name: getRouteCollector
methods.description: Returns the underlying RouteCollectorInterface instance that manages the actual route registration.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Gets the base path prefix applied to all routes in this proxy.

methods.name: setBasePath
methods.description: Sets the base path prefix for all routes in this proxy.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Defines a GET route with the given pattern and handler.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Defines a POST route with the given pattern and handler.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Defines a PUT route with the given pattern and handler.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Defines a PATCH route with the given pattern and handler.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Defines a DELETE route with the given pattern and handler.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Defines an OPTIONS route with the given pattern and handler.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Defines a route that responds to multiple HTTP methods.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Defines a route with specific HTTP methods, pattern, and handler.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Creates a group of routes with a common prefix pattern.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Creates a route that redirects from one URL to another with a specified status code.
